title: Canned lines duplicated across services are deduplicated on one visit
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit work orders, on the build under test.
  2. A due service is visible on a work order, the worklist or the asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Add two services that share a canned line (e.g. both include an oil change) to one work order.
  2. Confirm the shared line is not added twice.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Canned lines duplicated across services are deduplicated, so a unit never gets oil twice on one visit.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10573 (S17, Add a service to a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S17; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
